name: American Ink Screen Printing, Embroidery & Promotional
old_description: Champion® brand: giving you the confidence to play by your own rules Since 1919.
about:
American Ink Screen Printing, Embroidery & Promotional operates from Sioux Falls, South Dakota. The company was founded in 1919 and remains an owned-and-operated business serving the greater Midwest region. While the original founders are not named in public records, the firm has built its reputation on in-house customization of apparel and promotional items.

The shop specializes in screen printing and embroidery, offering an 8-color spot process along with specialty inks such as discharge, puff, and glitter. All decoration work is completed in-house, allowing the team to control quality and turnaround. Beyond decoration, the company sources and sells a wide range of blank apparel — t-shirts, jackets, polos, caps, sweatshirts — and promotional products from brands including Bella+Canvas, Carhartt, Under Armour, and Titleist. They also provide custom artwork design, vector file conversion, and can set up web stores for fundraisers or wholesale programs.

Customers range from local businesses and schools to charitable organizations, corporate event planners, spirit clubs, and athletic teams. Orders can be as small as six pieces and scale to 200-plus items, with the company quoting four quantity tiers (6–50, 51–100, 101–200, 200+). A new free-delivery service within five miles of Sioux Falls was added for 2026.

American Ink emphasizes a competitive price point and a turnaround time described as 'second to none,' backed by the policy of keeping all production under one roof. The firm also highlights its custom design capability, where artists create artwork based on client input for a quick, affordable result.

name: American Iron Works
old_description: At American Iron Works, we offer custom made-to-order metal fabrications in Iron, Stainless Steel, Aluminum, Bronze and more. We can design any style to fit the aesthetic of your commercial space, residential home, or any custom piece you desire. With over 40 years of experience and a great passion for our trade, we ensure our customers across Connecticut will receive high-quality products and services. Contact us at
about:
American Iron Works operates from New Haven, Connecticut, where it has served clients for over 40 years. The business began as a passion project of Pasquale, the father and grandfather of the current owners, and has grown into a third-generation family-owned and operated shop now led by Anthony and Joe Maresca.

The company produces custom ornamental metal fabrications in iron, stainless steel, aluminum, and bronze. Its capabilities span welding (stick, MIG, and TIG), metal craft (manual grinding, cutting, chamfering, bending, punching, shearing, and plasma cutting), and finishing (sandblasting, powder coating, galvanizing, and patinas). The team manages projects from material sourcing through fabrication, finishing, and installation.

American Iron Works serves both commercial and residential customers throughout Connecticut. Commercial projects include structural ironwork, partition walls, and fire-escape renovations, while residential work covers railings, gates, balconies, pergolas, and decorative pieces such as CNC plasma-cut sunbursts and hand-forged branch-design rails.

The Maresca brothers attribute the firm’s reputation to fine craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a commitment to custom work that reflects each client’s aesthetic. The business was founded on a passion for metal craft and a desire to pass the trade down to future generations.

name: American Metal Fabricators
old_description: American Metal Fabricators has a proven history fabricating with a variety of materials including steel, stainless steel, and aluminum.
about:
American Metal Fabricators operates from a 200,000-square-foot facility in Gastonia, North Carolina, just outside Charlotte. The company has been serving customers since 1988, though the founders and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication across a range of processes: MIG, TIG, stick, and flux-core welding; shearing and forming with 15 press brakes (up to 14 feet, 400+ tons) and five shears (½-inch capacity, 12-foot length); plasma cutting on four tables handling 10-foot-wide by 40-foot-long material; sand blasting to SP6–SP10 profiles with media recovery; angle, pipe, and channel rolling; and a 500-foot rail paint line with a downdraft booth and chemical pretreatment. The facility includes a 30,000-square-foot sandblast building, high-bay overhead cranes, and drive-through truck access. Workforce includes welders, fabricators, pipefitters, electricians, machinists, painters, mechanics, designers, drafters, schedulers, expediters, and QA/QC inspectors. The company also manufactures insulated foam panels (1–6 inches thick, up to 4 feet wide and 14+ feet long) with polyurethane cores tested to ASTM E84 and meeting SNAP 2021, plus foam-panel doors, duct doors, and marine access doors.

Customers span power generation, utilities, microelectronics, paper, pulp, fibers, textiles, wood, furniture, food and beverage, chemicals, plastics, paint, printing, heavy equipment, and pharmaceutical industries. Typical projects include air washers, air handling units, energy recovery systems, dryers, ovens, furnaces, plenums, duct systems, dust filtration, gas turbine filtration, mining equipment, humidification systems, mist eliminators, acoustic enclosures, scrubbers, spray systems, and evaporative cooling systems.

The company emphasizes its ability to handle large, complex jobs with short lead times while also accommodating smaller orders, supported by its expansive facility and skilled labor pool in the Gastonia industrial area.

name: American Precision Products
old_description: A leading supplier of custom injection molded products since 1972 American Precision Products can handle your molding program.
about:
American Precision Products was founded in 1972 in Huntsville, Alabama, as a custom injection molding firm. The company has operated continuously from its Alabama base for over five decades.

The company molds thermoplastics, thermoplastic elastomers, and thermoset materials, offering processes that include custom injection molding, miniature and micro molding, compression and transfer molding, insert and overmolding, and prototyping. It maintains in-house mold building and tooling capabilities while also coordinating overseas tooling for customers. Production runs range from short prototype batches to long-volume orders, with a dedicated micro-molding cell that has used high-speed, high-pressure presses since 1987.

American Precision Products serves military, aerospace, commercial, and government customers. Its work emphasizes highly controlled manufacturing specifications—tolerances, cosmetics, and production control measures—tailored to aerospace and defense requirements.

The firm positions its injection molding approach as faster, more accurate, and more repeatable than traditional transfer and compression molding, encouraging customers with existing compression programs to switch for cost savings and quality improvements.

American Sewing Workroom, LLC (ASW) operates as a family-owned contract sewing and product development shop in Roswell, Georgia, within the metro Atlanta area. The company does not disclose its founding year, but its chief executive is a professional tailor with extensive fashion-industry experience who can translate spontaneous ideas into patterns.

ASW provides a full spectrum of garment production services, including pattern making, grading, prototyping, cutting, sewing, and embroidery. The workroom positions itself as a one-stop resource for both established apparel lines and entrepreneurs entering the garment industry, handling each phase from concept through finished goods. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The client base consists primarily of women's and children's fashion designers, both local and out-of-state. ASW works with designers who need development support as well as those ready for production runs, though minimum order quantities and typical lead times are not specified.

The company emphasizes domestic manufacturing, stating it is proud to make products in the U.S. where "quality matters." It differentiates itself through the CEO's pattern-making expertise, a team of skilled technicians and product-development specialists, and attention to detail described as unparalleled in the industry.

name: American Sheet Metal Fabricators
old_description: American Sheet Metal Fabricators, Inc. “ASM” is a developed Union Local 73 fabrication shop in Chicagoland’s south side.  At American Sheet Metal Fabricators Inc, we are dedicated to providing our customers with high quality products and services at affordable prices. We value your business. We have made it our mission to provide reliable products and services in our customer-driven approach.
about:
American Sheet Metal Fabricators (ASM) operates as a Union Local 73 fabrication shop in South Holland, Illinois, on Chicago's south side. The business is led by the DeBartolo family: Dennis DeBartolo serves as president, Frank DeBartolo as vice president, Anthony DeBartolo as superintendent, and Christine DeBartolo as treasurer.

The shop produces a broad range of HVAC ductwork and fittings, including lockformed rectangular straight duct, snaplock and Pittsburgh-lock systems, welded rectangular and round duct in gauges from 16 ga to 1/4-inch black iron, stainless, and galvanized, double-wall rectangular and spiral duct with solid or perforated inner liners, spiral pipe from 4 to 40 inches in diameter, and acoustical liner installations. It also fabricates roof caps, custom drain pans, roof curbs, platform curbs, roof rails, register boxes, and painted duct components. Pre-assembled duct runs with collars and taps sealed and wrapped are offered as a labor-saving option, and same-day pickup is available for residential plenums, duct, and return-air elbows.

ASM serves mechanical and HVAC contractors in the Chicagoland area. A testimonial from the EMCOR Team, a national mechanical construction firm, references quick turnaround on orders, and the product line includes residential plenums and duct for same-day change-outs.

The company states its mission is to provide the highest quality products at the most reasonable prices, with fabrication to SMACNA standards and a focus on urgent delivery needs such as same-day pickup for change-out work.

old_description: Our continued commitment to service, quality and product innovation have established Rampage Products as a significant leader of premium parts and accessories in the specialty Jeep, Truck, SUV and UTV marketplace. Our team of industry enthusiasts not only use our products, but also contribute to the many new ideas and product innovations you can see today on our website and in our catalog. Together we invite you to review our program; use our products; and join our growing family of satisfied customers.
about:
American Tire and Motorsports operates from a single facility at 689 McLean Avenue in Yonkers, New York. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed on its website.

The business functions as a retail and installation center for aftermarket automotive parts and accessories, focusing on pickup trucks, SUVs, Jeeps, and UTVs. Its service offerings include custom fabrication projects and interior/exterior coating applications, notably DINITROL rust proofing. The shop stocks and installs products from brands such as Rampage Products, Buyers Products Company, ZROADZ Off Road Products, RIGID Industries, Westin Automotive, Artec Industries, and Energy Suspension. Product categories span automotive lighting, bumpers and grille guards, cargo management, suspension systems, towing accessories, truck bed covers, wheels and tires, winches, and bedliners.

The company serves individual vehicle owners and enthusiasts seeking upgrades for off-road and on-road use. Its customer base includes drivers of Chevrolet, Dodge, Ford, GMC, Jeep, Land Rover, Ram, and Toyota vehicles who require professional installation of purchased parts.

American Tire and Motorsports positions itself as a one-stop provider where customers can purchase parts and have them installed on-site, summarized by the slogan "BUY A PART? WE CAN INSTALL IT!" The team describes itself as industry enthusiasts who personally use the products they sell.

name: American Wire Group
old_description: AWG specializes in providing wire and cable solutions for use in wind, solar, battery energy storage and EV infrastructure applications.
about:
Based in Aventura, Florida, with operation centers in Perris, California; Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania; and Katy, Texas, American Wire Group (AWG) marks 25 years as a supplier and manufacturer of wire, cable, hardware, and accessories for utility and renewable energy markets. The company describes itself as a partner for industries that power the grid, though it does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

AWG maintains what it calls the largest inventory of wire and cable products in the United States, stocked across its coast-to-coast warehouses to enable delivery in days rather than weeks. Its capabilities span custom cable engineering and design, cable management and logistics, supply chain optimization, and a suite of value-added services such as cut-to-length, custom labeling, paralleling, connector installation, and reel recycling. The company also operates a 24/7 emergency response team that deploys materials for disaster recovery and grid restoration.

The company serves utilities, government agencies, and private-sector businesses in power transmission and distribution, substations, wind and solar farms, battery energy storage systems, data centers, and electric-vehicle charging infrastructure. Customers include utility companies and emergency response teams that rely on AWG for hard-to-find items and rapid material support during crises.

AWG emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system, its nationwide inventory footprint, and its ability to provide engineered solutions from concept through installation as key differentiators. The firm states that its emergency response capabilities and comprehensive service model set it apart from competitors that only supply products.

name: American Wood Design, Inc.
old_description: Award-Winning Commercial Cabinetry & Architectural Millwork Since 1996
about:
American Wood Design, Inc. is a family-owned commercial cabinetry and architectural millwork shop based in Chester, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1996 by Michael Gilhool Sr., the business began after his position at a Philadelphia paint company’s display shop was eliminated; he bartered the shop’s machinery for his first two store-fixture jobs and started production above a doctor’s office in South Philadelphia. After nearly two decades at Naamans Road Business Park, the company relocated to Chester in 2017, expanding from 5,000 to 16,000 square feet.

The shop produces custom cabinets, countertops, reception desks, nurse stations, office front systems, wall paneling, trim, mouldings, and wood base. It runs plastic laminate layups, solid-surface fabrication, and granite, marble, and quartz countertop work. Core processes include CNC routing, computerized beam saw cutting, and edgebanding, supported by software that drives the machinery. The 16,000-square-foot facility is set up for high-volume production runs while remaining nimble enough for small projects.

Customers span commercial construction, healthcare, retail, and architectural millwork sectors throughout the Greater Philadelphia region. Early work included a reception desk for M.A.B. Paints; today the firm serves office fit-outs, medical facilities needing custom nurse stations, and retail chains requiring store fixtures and wall systems.

The company emphasizes building cabinetry and relationships that last a lifetime, delivering craftsmanship on time and on budget. It differentiates itself with fast lead times — offering 3- to 5-day turnaround on wholesale plastic laminate panel layups — and a willingness to handle both large production runs and one-off jobs.

name: Americor Electronics Ltd
old_description: Manufacturing power cords, cable & wire harnesses and other electric and electronic components for the world since 1988.
about:
Americor Electronics Ltd. was founded in 1988 by Tom Pross in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. Pross brought 22 years of experience in power cord, cable, and wire harness production to the venture, establishing a supplier network that spans the globe.

The company manufactures custom and standard power cords (including locking, medical, and international configurations), cable assemblies, and wire harnesses. It also produces a range of electronic components such as solenoids, relays, axial fans, terminal blocks, piezo electric devices, EMI/RFI filters, and transformers. Beyond fabrication, Americor provides prototyping, testing support, documentation for approval, and post-order inventory management with scheduled shipping. Standard items are sourced from overseas partners, while custom designs are built to customer specifications.

Americor serves original equipment manufacturers and distributors exclusively, with a focus on the appliance, electric, and electronic industries. Longtime customers include Pulsafeeder, an Idex Corporation business that named Americor its 2019 Supplier of the Year. The firm also acts as the U.S. manufacturer's representative for Germany's Adels Contact, supplying terminal blocks, connector systems, and high-power LED distribution boxes.

Pross founded the business to leverage his deep supplier relationships and deliver custom products that guarantee maximum function and cost efficiency. The operation maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification and RoHS compliance, and holds membership in the Wiring Harness Manufacturer's Association.
